statements.__comment__: Link NaisApp to KubernetesContainer via cryptographic image digest (preferred over tag-based match). Only runs when NaisApp.image_digest is populated.
statements.query: MATCH (a:NaisApp), (c:KubernetesContainer) WHERE a.image_digest IS NOT NULL AND c.status_image_sha IS NOT NULL AND c.status_image_sha = a.image_digest MERGE (a)-[r:RUNS_IMAGE]->(c) ON CREATE SET r.firstseen = timestamp() SET r.lastupdated = $UPDATE_TAG
MATCH (a:NaisApp)-[r:RUNS_IMAGE]->(c:KubernetesContainer) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE r RETURN COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
